units.source_text: 為了讓他就範，我首先在臉上堆滿偽基督教徒式的「善意」媚笑，

en.t: To bring him to heel, I first plastered my face with a sycophantic smile of pseudo-Christian "goodwill,"

units.source_text: 頭向左歪三十度左右，輕輕摟住他瘦小的肩膀，

en.t: tilted my head about thirty degrees to the left, and gently put my arm around his small, thin shoulders,

units.source_text: 用媚言蜜語的肉麻聲，邀請他到我寄宿的親戚家來玩，

en.t: then, in a sickeningly sweet, coaxing voice, invited him to come play at the relatives' house where I was boarding,

units.source_text: 但他總是眼神茫然呆滯，一聲不吭。

en.t: but he would always gaze blankly and dully, without saying a word.

units.source_text: 不過，有一天放學後，記得是在初夏，一場驟雨突如其來，

en.t: However, one day after school, I remember it was early summer, a sudden shower came out of nowhere,

units.source_text: 同學們都在為怎麼回家而一籌莫展，

en.t: and all the students were at a loss over how to get home,

units.source_text: 我因為住得離學校很近，不以為然地正要衝出室外時，

en.t: since I lived very close to the school, I was just about to dash outside without much concern,

units.source_text: 驀然看見竹一正滿臉沮喪地站在鞋櫃的後面，

en.t: when I suddenly saw Takeichi standing behind the shoe lockers with a thoroughly dejected look on his face,

units.source_text: 就跟他說：「走吧，我把傘借給你！」

en.t: so I said to him, "Come on, I will lend you my umbrella!"

units.source_text: 便一把拽住怯生生的竹一，一起狂奔在驟雨中。

en.t: then grabbed the timid Takeichi and ran with him through the downpour.
